review_text: It’s our second time here. On our first visit, we only had coffee, but this time we also tried their chicken parmigiana pasta and clubhouse sandwich thanks to their 50% anniversary promo. I was pleasantly surprised that the food quality was not compromised at all despite the discount. Everything was delicious, and the serving sizes were generous. We’ll definitely be back to try their bolognese pasta and loaded nachos, those seemed to be crowd favorites. 😊

⭐️ 1 star for service — not because the staff weren’t attentive or helpful, but because of the poor basic service. We had to ask for service water before it was given, when it should be standard procedure to serve water while customers are waiting for their orders, right? We also asked for any kind of hot sauce — not available. And worst of all, when we requested for table napkins, they said none were available! Imagine dining without napkins? So disappointing. I ordered the Aglio Olio, and the toasted bread on the side was literally soaked in oil instead of being toasted. Definitely not a pleasant dining experience.

The food is great, and I really enjoyed it. However, some of the drinks had a slightly odd taste, maybe it’s the beans, though it could just be my personal preference. The atmosphere overall is decent. That said, I’d like to point out a few concerns. This morning, some of the staff were quite noisy, which was noticeable since many of the customers were students trying to study or work. A few even had to move seats because they couldn’t focus due to the noise. I also observed that tables were not being cleared promptly. Used plates and glasses were left on tables for a while, making the place look messy and affecting the overall ambiance. Another issue I experienced was at the cashier. They kept asking for the exact amount when paying. While I understand the need for smaller bills or coins, it was frustrating because I was unable to provide the exact amount at the time. Because of this, I ended up not ordering additional food, which was disappointing. Overall, the food is good, but I hope these areas, especially staff behavior, table maintenance, and payment flexibility can be improved to enhance the customer experience.

For me, this cafe promotes a study-friendly environment, but does a study-friendly atmosphere really include music that makes you feel like you're in a mini bar? Most cafes that excel in this regard play calming music suitable for studying. Overall, it's a good cafe, but the music selection leaves much to be desired. No offense to the barista who shares their taste with everyone!
